comments: kernel3 + dropout, trained from random init (no --finetune) -- tests whether pretrained (native-checkpoint) initialization is actually helping or hurting once dropout is added, since every finetune+X combination tried so far (shallow_encoder, 2-frame, the 3-regularizer combo) has underperformed its from-scratch or single-technique counterpart. Same dropout_rate=0.1, no weight_decay/label_smoothing, as kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json -- only the init source differs. Compare against: kernel3-from-scratch-no-dropout (0.3156), kernel3+finetune+dropout (running in parallel), plain finetune (0.3684).
